meta.principle: 全功能但只有一个 owner：去重但保留全功能。Board 独有能力必须迁入 Review，不得静默删除。
meta.freshness_correction: Canonical Review compute_scope_observation top keys are scope/price/trend/structure/momentum/participation/chip — NO freshness layer. Legacy filter_engine/metric_engine freshness is RETIRED from mandatory main chain, so cannot be cited as canonical owner. Board event freshness is BOARD_UNIQUE -> MIGRATE_TO_REVIEW.

dag: - Event Freshness (MIGRATED from Board — add freshness layer to Review)
- Technical Structure (technical_state_concentration / dispersion MIGRATED from Board)
target_architecture.slice1r_scope: ONLY define target. Do NOT physically delete tables/columns/publications this slice.

already_owned_by_review: Review Leadership (leader_set from actual member contribution)

migrate_from_board.reason: Canonical Review has NO freshness layer. Board computes today/last_5d/10d/20d event counts + by_dimension{trend/structure/momentum/chip}.density + decay_weighted_density. Must migrate into Review as a new freshness layer (Slice 2 defines exact windows/formulas).
migrate_from_board.verification_required: Slice 2: add Review freshness layer; parity vs Board freshness (today/5d/10d/20d + by_dimension + decay).

migrate_from_board.reason: Board HHI over trend-strength magnitude; Review price/amount concentration uses different input (abs-price-change share / amount share). Board answers 'is trend-strength concentrated' — Review does not cover this. Preserve as technical_state_concentration.
Board std/cv over trend-strength magnitude; Review return distribution uses price_returns. Different underlying variable. Preserve as technical_state_dispersion.

Review canonical v2.3 FORMALLY removed active_ob_count (like Turnover). Board still exposes avg_active_ob_count. Per the consolidation principle 'dedupe but preserve full functionality', the decision is made: MIGRATE_TO_REVIEW. Board runtime is itself a RETIRE target, so it cannot remain 'Board-only'. Must not be silently dropped.
migrate_from_board.verification_required: Slice 2: re-add avg_active_ob_count as a retained Review fact (single batch-prepare from member facts).

migrate_from_board.reason: Board stores avg+P25+P50+P75 of fp_trend_strength; Review trend.continuous.regime_strength persists ONLY a median. LOSSY. MIGRATE_TO_REVIEW: extend regime_strength to {mean,p25,p50,p75,valid_count}.
migrate_from_board.verification_required: Slice 2: extend Review trend.continuous.regime_strength distribution helper.

migrate_from_board.reason: Board stores avg+P25+P50+P75 of (close-vwap)/vwap*100; Review trend.continuous.dsa_vwap_dev_pct persists ONLY a median. LOSSY and DISTINCT from amount_concentration. MIGRATE_TO_REVIEW: extend dsa_vwap_dev_pct to {mean,p25,p50,p75,valid_count}.
migrate_from_board.verification_required: Slice 2: extend Review trend.continuous.dsa_vwap_dev_pct distribution helper.

migrate_from_board.reason: Board momentum_phase is a SEPARATE dimension from momentum direction state. Review momentum.state (direction) + transition (T-1→T) do NOT cover enhancing/fading/flat change counts. DIFFERENT_SEMANTICS. MIGRATE_TO_REVIEW: add momentum.change {enhancing_count, weakening_count, flat_count, denominator}.
migrate_from_board.verification_required: Slice 2: add momentum.change node to Review momentum output.

migrate_from_board.reason: SQZMOM oscillator is a DISTINCT metric from BB position/width/squeeze_state. Review momentum has NO sqzmom aggregate. Not RETIRE (unique Board capability). MIGRATE_TO_REVIEW: add momentum.sqzmom {mean, valid_count}.
migrate_from_board.verification_required: Slice 2: add momentum.sqzmom aggregate to Review momentum output.

migrate_from_board.reason: Board volume badge counts are NOT recoverable from Review participation.volume p25/p50/p75. LOSSY. MIGRATE_TO_REVIEW: add participation.volume.badge {high_count, low_count, normal_count, unknown_count}.
migrate_from_board.verification_required: Slice 2: add volume badge counts to Review participation.volume.

migrate_from_board.reason: Board avg volume ratio is NOT recoverable from Review ratio20/200 median/percentiles (different aggregation). LOSSY. MIGRATE_TO_REVIEW: add mean to participation.volume.ratio20/ratio200 distributions.
migrate_from_board.verification_required: Slice 2: extend participation.volume.ratio20/ratio200 to emit mean.

migrate_from_board.reason: Board percentile_20/200_dist 5-bin histogram is NOT recoverable from Review p25/p50/p75. LOSSY. MIGRATE_TO_REVIEW: add histogram_20_40_60_80 to participation.volume.percentile20/percentile200.

Board V1 reads CURRENT snapshot latest-event state ('does this stock currently have a recent BOS / what direction?'). Review structure.events reads EXACT-T immutable event incidence ('how many BOS happened today?'). DIFFERENT_TIME_SEMANTICS. MIGRATE_TO_REVIEW: retain latest-event state as a Review Current-State node, complementary to exact-T events + event freshness.
migrate_from_board.verification_required: Slice 2: add latest-event state node to Review structure output.

derive_from_review.reason: Board diffusion fully derived from state_transitions. Review filter_engine derives diffusion from canonical state.transition facts. Prohibit a second stored diffusion fact.
Derivable from Review canonical transition + state facts; do not store a second copy.

retire_conflicting_definition.reason: Board uses change_magnitude vs median + board-direction majority; Review Leadership uses actual member contribution vector (Leader Set + T-1→T migration). Review is more formal owner. Board definition retired, no double-track. NOTE: lives in concept_extras, NOT a separate pyramid_v2.leadership key.
retire_conflicting_definition.disposition: RETIRE (conflicting, Review Leadership is canonical owner)

retire_conflicting_definition.reason: Board uses vs-market/parent ratio + label; Review C1 cross-sectional is the relative-strength owner (peer percentile rank). Board label retired.
retire_conflicting_definition.disposition: RETIRE (conflicting, Review C1 is canonical owner)

lineage infrastructure; must not be retired by analytics layer.
